title: Links and requests
description: Issue records, access public content, and stop future access.

sections.title: Issue a share
paragraphs: GET /v1/files/:id/share requires operator authentication. Preserve the full returned URL, including exp and sig. Do not construct your own untracked URL.
GET /s/:link/meta returns metadata and records an open. GET /s/:link returns file bytes. Both validate the signature, expiry, and issued record.

sections.title: Issue a file request
paragraphs: POST /v1/requests accepts a JSON object with folder. GET /r/:token describes an active request; PUT /r/:token uploads raw bytes into that saved folder.
X-Loft-Name supplies the uploaded filename. Public upload headers cannot change the saved destination.

sections.title: Manage active records
paragraphs: GET /v1/sharing lists active records and their URLs. DELETE /v1/sharing/:link revokes a share or closes a request. Both require the operator bearer.

sections.title: Expiry and revocation
paragraphs: Issued shares and requests expire after seven days. Revocation stops subsequent requests; in-flight transfers may finish. Revoking a link does not remove the underlying file or previously received uploads.
